a1
Joseph could not hold back. He sent everyone out and wept so loudly the Egyptians heard.
a2
He said: I am Joseph. Is my father still alive? His brothers could not answer.
b1
Come closer, he said. I am your brother Joseph, whom you sold into Egypt.
b2
Do not be angry with yourselves. God sent me ahead of you to save lives.
c1
It was God, not you, who sent me. Tell my father to come and live in Goshen, near me.
c2
He embraced Benjamin, wept, and kissed all his brothers. Then they talked.
d1
Pharaoh was glad. He said: bring your father and families, and I will give you the best of Egypt.
d2
They told Jacob: Joseph is alive and rules Egypt. He did not believe them, until he saw the wagons Joseph had sent. Then he said: I will go and see him before I die.
h1
Joseph said: I am the one you sold. Then he said: come closer.
h2
He told the truth about the harm, and he opened the door anyway.
h3
Peace needs honest words about what happened, and an open hand.
h4
Today, step toward someone you have drifted from.
i
Who do you need to invite closer again?
